translations.literal: Our small state's soldiers and people, harassed beyond endurance, abandon their districts and migrate inland.
translations.idiomatic: Our kingdom's soldiers and civilians, harassed beyond endurance, abandon their home districts and flee inland.

sentences.zh: 遼民逐食，亦隨而入。

translations.literal: Liaodong people seeking food also follow them in.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong refugees, chasing after food, follow them inland as well.

sentences.zh: 自昌、義以南，安、肅以北，客居六七，主居三四。

translations.literal: From Chang and Ui south, and An and Suk north, guests occupy six or seven tenths and hosts three or four.
translations.idiomatic: From Chang and Ui in the south to An and Suk in the north, outsiders outnumber natives six or seven to three or four.

sentences.zh: 向者將此情形具奏，見兵部題覆處分已定，何敢再幹。

translations.literal: Earlier I fully reported this situation; seeing that the Ministry of War's response and disposition is settled, how dare I raise it again.
translations.idiomatic: I reported this situation in full earlier; seeing that the Ministry of War has already settled on a course of action, how dare I raise it again.

sentences.zh: 至韓潤及弟潭系逆賊明璉子侄，亡命潛逃，因而勾引來寇。

translations.literal: As for Han Run and his brother Tan—they are the sons and nephews of the rebel Minglian—they fled as outlaws and thus enticed raiders to come.
translations.idiomatic: As for Han Run and his brother Tan—the sons and nephews of the rebel Minglian—they fled as outlaws and thus lured invaders to attack.

sentences.zh: 賊既叛國而去，制命已不在臣。

translations.literal: Having rebelled against the country and left, control over them is no longer in my hands.
translations.idiomatic: Having rebelled against the realm and fled, they are no longer under my authority.

sentences.zh: 尹義立曾任判書，本非議政。

translations.literal: Yin Yili once served as Minister of the Board of Rites and Letters; he was never State Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Yili once served as Minister of the Board of Rites and Letters; he was never a State Councillor.

sentences.zh: 頃年差為毛鎮接伴官，不稱任使，褫職歸家，並無怨叛之事。

translations.literal: In recent years he was detailed as liaison officer for Commander Mao; he did not suit the assignment, was stripped of office and returned home—there was no grudge or rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years he was assigned as liaison officer to Commander Mao; he proved unsuited to the post, was stripped of office, and returned home—there was no disloyalty or rebellion in his case.

sentences.zh: 毛鎮據王仲保等所訴，都無實事。

translations.literal: Commander Mao, based on complaints from Wang Zhongbao and others, found no facts at all.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Mao's charges, based on complaints from Wang Zhongbao and others, had no basis in fact.

sentences.zh: 意必有讒邪之臣，欺妄督撫，以售其交構之計者。

translations.literal: I suspect there must be slanderous officials deceiving the supervising grand coordinator to sell their plot of entrapment.
translations.idiomatic: I suspect that slanderous officials have deceived the supervising grand coordinator to carry out a plot of entrapment.

sentences.zh: 毛帥久鎮海外，臣與周旋已近十稔。

translations.literal: Commander Mao has long garrisoned beyond the sea; your subject has dealt with him for nearly ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Mao has long held his post beyond the sea; I have worked with him for nearly ten years.

sentences.zh: 雖餼牽將竭，彼此俱困，而情誼之殷，實無少損。

translations.literal: Although gifts and sustenance are nearly exhausted, both sides alike in hardship, the depth of friendship has truly not diminished in the least.
translations.idiomatic: Though gifts and provisions are nearly exhausted and both sides alike suffer hardship, the depth of our friendship has not diminished in the least.

sentences.zh: 且其須彌之遷，直為保護累重，將以就便芻薪。

translations.literal: Moreover, his move to Xumi was solely to protect his numerous dependents and to obtain firewood conveniently.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, his move to Xumi was solely to protect his large following and to obtain firewood more conveniently.

sentences.zh: 一進一退，兵家常事。

translations.literal: Advance and retreat—the common circumstance of soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Advance and retreat are the common lot of armies.

sentences.zh: 訛言噂遝，本不介意。

translations.literal: Misleading talk and gossip—I originally gave it no mind.
translations.idiomatic: Slander and gossip—I originally paid them no heed.

sentences.zh: 竊見部撫移咨曰「虞其逼處」，曰「驅其民，驅其帥」，甚至有「布兵以防，屬國攜貳」之語，似海外情事，未盡諒悉。

translations.literal: I have seen the Ministry and grand coordinator's dispatch saying 'fearing he presses too close,' saying 'drive away his people, drive away his commander,' even to the words 'deploy troops in defense, the tributary state wavers in loyalty'—it seems affairs beyond the sea are not fully understood with sympathy.
translations.idiomatic: I have seen the Ministry and grand coordinator's dispatch speak of 'fearing he presses too close,' of 'driving away his people and driving away his commander,' even of 'deploying troops in defense because the tributary state wavers in loyalty'—it seems affairs beyond the sea are not fully understood.

sentences.zh: 臣之請刷遼民，因力不足濟，初非慮及逼處也。

translations.literal: My request to move out Liaodong people was because strength was insufficient to assist—not at first from concern about pressing too close.
translations.idiomatic: My request to relocate the Liaodong refugees arose because we lacked the strength to support them—not from any fear that they pressed too close.

sentences.zh: 臣方與毛鎮同心一力，建功報主，豈敢有一毫猜防意乎。

translations.literal: Your subject is now of one heart and one effort with Commander Mao, building merit to repay the lord—how could I dare have the slightest suspicion?
translations.idiomatic: I am now of one heart and one purpose with Commander Mao, striving to build merit and repay our sovereign—how could I harbor the slightest suspicion?

sentences.zh: 帝報曰：「王和協東鎮，愛戴中朝，忠貞之忱，溢乎言表。

translations.literal: The emperor replied: "The king harmonizes with the eastern garrison and cherishes the Central Dynasty; loyalty and sincerity overflow his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "The king works in harmony with the eastern garrison and cherishes the Central Dynasty; loyalty and sincerity overflow his words.

sentences.zh: 鎮軍久懸，鮮、遼雜處。

translations.literal: The garrison army has long been suspended; Koreans and Liaodong people live intermixed.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison has long been stationed abroad, and Koreans and Liaodong refugees live intermixed.

sentences.zh: 久客累主，生寡食多。

translations.literal: Long guests wear down their host; many mouths, little produce.
translations.idiomatic: Long-staying guests burden their host; many mouths consume what little is produced.

sentences.zh: 微王言，朕有不坐照萬里之外者。

translations.literal: But for the king's words, I would have failed to see clearly ten thousand li away.
translations.idiomatic: But for the king's words, I would have failed to see clearly what is happening ten thousand li away.

sentences.zh: 然毛帥在中朝為牽制之師，在王國則脣齒之形也。

translations.literal: Yet Commander Mao, for the Central Dynasty is a force checking the enemy; for your kingdom he is the form of lip and teeth.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Commander Mao, for the Ming is a force holding the enemy in check; for your kingdom he is lip to your teeth.

sentences.zh: 海上芻輓，已令該部區畫，刻期運濟。

translations.literal: Fodder and transport on the sea—I have already ordered the responsible ministry to plan and deliver on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Fodder and transport by sea—I have already ordered the responsible ministry to arrange delivery on schedule.

sentences.zh: 逃難邊民，亦令毛帥悉心計處，俾無重為王累。

translations.literal: Fugitive frontier people—I have also ordered Commander Mao to plan carefully so they will not again heavily burden the king.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees from the frontier—I have also ordered Commander Mao to manage them carefully so they will not again become a heavy burden on the king.

sentences.zh: 傳訛之言，未足介懷，並力一心，王其勉之。」

translations.literal: Transmitted slander is not worth taking to heart; exert united effort and one heart—the king should strive."
translations.idiomatic: Rumors spread abroad are not worth taking to heart. Exert united effort with one heart—the king should strive."

sentences.zh: 七年三月，兵部上文龍揭言：「麗官、麗人招敵攻鐵山，傷我兵千人，殺麗兵六萬，焚糧百余萬，敵遂移兵攻麗矣。」

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, the Ministry of War forwarded Mao Wenlong's bulletin: "Korean officials and Korean people lured the enemy to attack Tieshan, wounding our soldiers by a thousand, killing Korean soldiers sixty thousand, burning over a million [units] of grain; the enemy then shifted troops to attack Korea."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year the Ministry of War forwarded Mao Wenlong's bulletin: "Korean officials and civilians lured the enemy to attack Tieshan, wounding a thousand of our soldiers, killing sixty thousand Korean troops, and burning more than a million units of grain; the enemy then turned their armies against Korea."

sentences.zh: 帝敕文龍速相機應援。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Wenlong to hurry and support as circumstances permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Wenlong to move quickly and render support as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 登撫李嵩奏：「朝鮮叛臣韓潤等引敵入安州，節度使南以興自焚死，中國援兵都司王三桂等俱陣亡。」

translations.literal: Dengzhou Grand Coordinator Li Song memorialized: "The Korean rebel minister Han Run and others led the enemy into Anzhou; Military Commissioner Nam Yixing burned himself to death; Chinese relief troops including Brigade Commander Wang Sangui all died in battle."
translations.idiomatic: Dengzhou Grand Coordinator Li Song memorialized: "The Korean rebel minister Han Run and others led the enemy into Anju; Military Commissioner Nam Yixing burned himself to death; Ming relief troops including Brigade Commander Wang Sangui all fell in battle."

sentences.zh: 既復奏：「義州及郭山、淩漢、山城俱破，平壤、黃州不戰自潰，敵兵直抵中和，游騎出入黃、鳳之間，又分向雲從，攻掠毛帥，國王及士民遷于江華以避難。」

translations.literal: He again memorialized: "Uiju and Guoshan, Linghan, and mountain fortresses were all taken; Pyongyang and Hwangju collapsed without fighting; enemy troops reached directly to Jungheung; raiding cavalry moved between Hwang and Phoenix; they also divided forces toward Yunchong to plunder Commander Mao; the king and officials and people moved to Ganghwa to escape disaster."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again: "Uiju, Guoshan, Linghan, and the mountain fortresses all fell; Pyongyang and Hwangju collapsed without a fight; enemy troops reached Jungheung; raiding cavalry ranged between Hwang and Phoenix; they also sent detachments toward Yunchong to attack Commander Mao; the king, officials, and people fled to Ganghwa to escape the disaster."

sentences.zh: 時大清兵所至輒下，朝鮮列城望風奔潰，乃遣使諭倧。

translations.literal: At that time wherever Great Qing troops arrived they took cities; Korean walled cities fled at the wind and collapsed; they then sent envoys to instruct Jeong.
translations.idiomatic: At that time wherever Qing armies marched they took city after city; Korea's walled towns collapsed at the mere rumor of their approach; the Qing then sent envoys to address Jeong.

sentences.zh: 倧輸款，遂班師。

translations.literal: Jeong offered submission; they thereupon withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Jeong submitted; the Qing thereupon withdrew their army.

sentences.zh: 九月，倧奏被兵情形。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Jeong memorialized on the circumstances of being attacked.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Jeong memorialized on the devastation wrought by the invasion.

sentences.zh: 時熹宗崩，莊烈帝嗣位，優詔勵勉焉。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Xizong died and the Chongzhen Emperor succeeded; an excellent edict encouraged and exhorted him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Xizong died and the Chongzhen Emperor succeeded to the throne; an edict of special favor encouraged and exhorted him.

sentences.zh: 崇禎二年，改每歲兩貢為一貢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongzhen, the twice-yearly tribute was changed to once a year.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chongzhen the twice-yearly tribute mission was reduced to once a year.

sentences.zh: 先是，遼路阻絕，貢使取道登、萊，已十餘年矣。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Liaodong route was cut off; tribute envoys took the route through Deng and Lai—for more than ten years already.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Liaodong route had been cut off, and tribute envoys had traveled through Dengzhou and Laizhou for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 自袁崇煥督師，題改覺華，迂途冒險，其國屢請復故。

translations.literal: When Yuan Chonghuan served as supervising commander, he proposed changing it to Juehua—a roundabout route full of danger; their country repeatedly requested restoration of the old route.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Chonghuan served as supervising commander, he changed the route to Juehua—a roundabout and perilous path—and Korea repeatedly asked that the old route be restored.

sentences.zh: 至是遣戶曹判書鄭鬥源從登海來，移書登撫孫元化，屬其陳請。

translations.literal: At this time Ministry of Personnel Minister Zheng Douyuan came from Deng and sea, sent a letter to Grand Coordinator Sun Yuanhua, asking him to memorialize on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Zheng Douyuan, Minister of the Board of Taxation, came by the Dengzhou sea route and sent a letter to Grand Coordinator Sun Yuanhua asking him to memorialize on Korea's behalf.

sentences.zh: 元化委官伴送，仍疏聞。

translations.literal: Yuanhua assigned officials to escort them and submitted a memorial reporting the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhua assigned officials to escort them and submitted a memorial reporting the matter.

sentences.zh: 帝以水路既有成命，改途嫌於自便，不許。

translations.literal: The Emperor, considering that a fixed order already existed for the sea route, regarded changing the route as self-serving convenience and did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, holding that a fixed order already governed the sea route, regarded a change of route as self-serving and refused.

sentences.zh: 是年六月，督師袁崇煥殺平遼將軍左都督毛文龍於雙島。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of that year, Grand Coordinator Yuan Chonghuan executed Mao Wenlong, Left Grand Guardian and Pacification General of Liaodong, on Shuangdao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of that year Grand Coordinator Yuan Chonghuan executed Mao Wenlong, Left Grand Guardian and Pacification General of Liaodong, on Shuangdao.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，倧遺書總兵黃龍言：「文龍舊將孔有德、耿仲明率士卒二萬投順大清，向朝鮮征糧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year, Jeong sent a letter to Regional Commander Huang Long stating: "Mao Wenlong's former generals Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming have led twenty thousand soldiers and surrendered to the Great Qing, and are now requisitioning grain from Joseon.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixth year Jeong wrote to Regional Commander Huang Long: "Mao Wenlong's former generals Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming have led twenty thousand troops in surrender to the Qing and are now requisitioning grain from Joseon.

sentences.zh: 本國以有德等曩在皮島為本國患，故未之應。」

translations.literal: Our state, because Youde and the others had formerly been a menace to us on Pidao, has therefore not complied."
translations.idiomatic: Our kingdom, because Youde and his men had formerly been a scourge to us on Pidao, has therefore refused."

sentences.zh: 龍以聞。

translations.literal: Long reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Long reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，太宗文皇帝親征朝鮮，責其渝盟助明之罪，列城悉潰。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year, the Taizong Wen Emperor personally campaigned against Joseon, rebuking them for breaking the alliance and aiding Ming; city after city collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year the Taizong Wen Emperor personally invaded Joseon, rebuking them for breaking the alliance and aiding Ming; city after city fell.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮告急，命總兵陳洪范調各鎮舟師赴援。

translations.literal: Joseon sent urgent appeals for help; Regional Commander Chen Hongfan was ordered to mobilize naval forces from the various garrisons to go to their aid.
translations.idiomatic: Joseon sent urgent appeals for help; Regional Commander Chen Hongfan was ordered to mobilize naval forces from the garrisons to go to their aid.

sentences.zh: 三月，洪范奏官兵出海。

translations.literal: In the third month, Hongfan memorialized that the troops and ships had put to sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Hongfan reported that the troops and ships had put to sea.

sentences.zh: 越數日，山東巡撫顏繼祖奏屬國失守，江華已破，世子被擒，國王出降。

translations.literal: A few days later, Shandong Grand Coordinator Yan Jizu memorialized that the tributary state had fallen: Ganghwa had been taken, the crown prince captured, and the king had surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: A few days later Shandong Grand Coordinator Yan Jizu reported that the tributary state had fallen: Ganghwa was taken, the crown prince captured, and the king had surrendered.

sentences.zh: 今大治舟艦，來攻皮島、鐵山，其鋒甚銳。

translations.literal: Now they are building warships on a large scale and coming to attack Pidao and Tieshan; their momentum is very sharp.
translations.idiomatic: They are now building warships in force and advancing against Pidao and Tieshan with great momentum.

sentences.zh: 宜急敕沈世魁、陳洪範二鎮臣，以堅守皮島為第一義。

translations.literal: An urgent order should be sent to the two garrison commanders Shen Shikui and Chen Hongfan that holding Pidao firm is the first priority.
translations.idiomatic: An urgent order should go to garrison commanders Shen Shikui and Chen Hongfan that holding Pidao firm is the first priority.

sentences.zh: 帝以繼祖不能協圖匡救，切責之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, holding that Jizu had failed to coordinate efforts to rescue and restore the situation, sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, holding that Jizu had failed to coordinate a rescue, sharply rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 亡何，皮島並為大清兵所破，朝鮮遂絕，不數載而明亦亡矣。

translations.literal: Before long, Pidao too was broken by Qing forces; contact with Joseon was severed, and within a few years Ming also perished.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Pidao too fell to Qing forces; contact with Joseon was severed, and within a few years Ming itself perished.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮在明雖稱屬國，而無異域內。

translations.literal: Though Joseon was called a tributary state under Ming, it was no different from territory within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Though Joseon was called a tributary state under Ming, it was treated little differently from territory within the realm.

sentences.zh: 故朝貢絡繹，錫賚便蕃，殆不勝書，止著其有關治亂者於篇。

translations.literal: Therefore tribute missions came in unbroken succession and imperial grants were frequent beyond counting; only matters bearing on order and disorder are recorded in this account.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute missions therefore came in unbroken succession and imperial grants were too numerous to record; only matters bearing on order and disorder are set down in this account.

sentences.zh: 至國之風土物產，則具載前史，茲不復錄。

translations.literal: As for the state's customs and local products, these are fully recorded in earlier histories and are not repeated here.
translations.idiomatic: As for the kingdom's customs and local products, these are fully recorded in earlier histories and are not repeated here.
